latest.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra, Its Half-Good AI Model at Half the Price
latest.description: OpenAI's mid-tier model now operates apps and screens more like a person would, with API prices 50% below GPT-5.6 Terra and an error rate that OpenAI says fell sharply.

latest.title: Anthropic's IPO puts power in the hands of founders, giving everyday shareholders little voice
latest.description: Founder LLC is one component of the "novel capital and corporate governance structure" that Anthropic outlined in its public S-1 filing.

latest.title: US OCC calls on community banks to become payment stablecoin issuers
latest.description: The announcement followed the banking regulator finalizing its rules for the GENIUS Act, a stablecoin law to be implemented in January

latest.title: Injective launches onchain futures market tracking Nvidia GPU rental costs
latest.description: The new index tracks rental prices for five Nvidia GPUs, offering leveraged trading and potential hedging against fluctuations in AI computing costs.

latest.title: JetBlue posts bigger loss on fuel costs, but CEO says margins improving
latest.description: JetBlue Airways is in the middle of a plan that aims to cut costs and increase premium revenue.

latest.title: Unitree Stock Jumps as Investors Bet Chatbot AI Will Finally Give Robots a Brain
latest.description: Unitree's shares have jumped about 60% in under two weeks as investors bet OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra will give robots the brains they lack, turning the stock into an AI proxy.

latest.title: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees as AI leads to efficiency push
latest.description: Microsoft is trying to balance a rapid AI infrastructure build-out with capital efficiency.

latest.title: NBA Embraces the CFTC on Prediction Markets as the NFL Fights It in Court
latest.description: The agreement, which follows similar deals with MLB and NHL, establishes information-sharing to guard against insider trading as sports betting migrates to CFTC-regulated venues.

latest.title: Meta, SpaceX, Anthropic stoke the AI funding frenzy. What it means for our stocks
Prediction market traders say an Anthropic IPO is near-certain this year after company filed with SEC
latest.description: Anthropic on Monday filed its Form S-1 with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

latest.title: South Korea Arrests Seven in First Big AI-Assisted Hacking Case
latest.description: Police in Seoul say a 32-year-old with no IT background used AI tools to break into about 90 hospitals, schools and companies, then pressed victims for roughly $270,000 combined.

latest.title: Trump DOJ unlawfully fired Epstein prosecutor Maurene Comey, judge rules
latest.description: The judge ordered that Maurene Comey, the daughter of ex-FBI director James Comey, be retroactively reinstated to her job as an assistant U.S. attorney.

latest.title: Canada opens consultation on stablecoins, citing US GENIUS Act
latest.description: As part of the potential implementation of its Stablecoin Act, the Canadian government will hear from the public on a proposed framework for tokens from non-financial institutions.

latest.title: AI Agents Found a Way Into Anthropic's Business Systems in Under 12 Hours
latest.description: Cathedral, a startup founded by ex-DOGE staffers, says its AI agents found paths into Anthropic's sales, HR, and IT systems through third-party software.

latest.title: Federal Reserve is likely to hold interest rates steady in October. Here's what that means for consumers
latest.description: The Federal Reserve is expected to keep its overnight rate unchanged at the conclusion of its October meeting this week.

latest.title: Oil ticks lower as Saudi defense minister meets with Iran's president in Tehran to de-escalate
latest.description: Investors are worried about the vulnerability of Saudi energy infrastructure and the risk of another disruption to production, refining or export facilities.

latest.title: Why Prediction Markets Got the Brazilian Election So Wrong
latest.description: Experts say Brazil's prediction market ban left the odds in the hands of traders with little knowledge about the election.

latest.title: Apple responds to user reports of broken iPhone Duo screens on new foldable phone
latest.description: Apple on Monday said it was aware of the issue and that it would replace the devices under its AppleCare warranty.

latest.title: AI company Anthropic announces IPO, expected as early as November
latest.description: The artificial intelligence company disclosed more than $16 billion in revenue and an $80 billion net loss for the first half of 2026.
